data.description: Lady Musance takes its name from music and dance. It is a concept installation shaped like a woman whose body is a guitar. In the drawings, a long slide curls down from her head and curved bars form her base, while a music note climbing wall and a harp-shaped climber stand nearby. Curved benches set around small lawns give room for casual singing, dancing and jamming, so adults use the area as much as children do. It is meant for a public park, a cultural centre or a large township garden that wants a landmark piece. As a concept, it has no standard size yet, and we develop the details with you, including age group and safe play area. When built, Lady Musance gets our 3-year warranty on the galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope it uses. Contact us to discuss a project.

items.pText: Lady Musance takes its name from music and dance. It is a concept installation shaped like a woman whose body is a guitar. In the drawings, a long slide curls down from her head and curved bars form her base, while a music note climbing wall and a harp-shaped climber stand nearby. Curved benches set around small lawns give room for casual singing, dancing and jamming, so adults use the area as much as children do. It is meant for a public park, a cultural centre or a large township garden that wants a landmark piece. As a concept, it has no standard size yet, and we develop the details with you, including age group and safe play area. When built, Lady Musance gets our 3-year warranty on the galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope it uses. Contact us to discuss a project.

Lady Musance exists as drawings, so its structure, materials and foundations are worked out for your site after discussion. We choose self-standing or grouted installation once we see the ground. The slide exit and climbers need impact-absorbing surfaces, while the benches can sit on grass. Plan regular checks of the slide, climbing holds and bench fixings.
